content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate and cross-region latency spikes detected for routing policy 'eu-fallback-v2'.

sre_oncall: Acknowledged. I'm on it. Seeing elevated 5xxs from eu-west1 -> us-east1 path.

netops_lead: Looking at global steering metrics. Weighting for eu-west1 dropped to 0.4 then oscillated. Could be TTL/prop sync causing split-horizon.

sre_oncall: I ran quick probe:
```
curl -sS -D - 'https://router.internal/route-check?from=eu-west1&to=us-east1'
# response: X-Route-Policy: eu-fallback-v2
# latency: 520ms
```

alice_m: Any recent policy rollouts? saw a deploy earlier to geo-router at 03:12 UTC.

eng_runtime: We pushed policy refresh (policy-id: p-9f2d) at 03:10. It included a TTL change from 60->10s for route pins.

sre_oncall: That matches. Short TTLs + partial propagation likely causing flapping and per-AZ divergence.

bob_r: Customer impact? Product support reported elevated API latency for customers in EU, intermittent 504s.

product_support: Confirmed — several enterprise customers reporting slow requests and timeouts starting ~03:15 UTC. No orders lost but degraded UX.

sre_oncall: Mitigation plan: 1) Pin-sync monitor on. 2) Revert TTL change to 60s via rctl. 3) Temporarily pause canary policy rollout. Executing step 2 now.

eng_runtime: Copy. Command:
```
rctl policy update p-9f2d --route-ttl 60
rctl rollout pause p-9f2d
```

netops_lead: Rolling back TTL now. Patching routing caches across CDN edges to expire stale pins.

incident-bot: Action logged: rctl policy update p-9f2d by eng_runtime. Incident assigned to sre_oncall.

sre_oncall: Seeing immediate reduction in oscillation on steering chart. 5xx rate trending down.

alice_m: Are we safe to unpause canary after stabilization? we should add a canary TTL lower bound in the operator.

eng_runtime: Agreed. We'll add validation to prevent TTL<15s for region pin policies. Filing task: RT#7891.

product_support: Drafting customer-facing note: 'We've identified and reverted a routing configuration change that caused intermittent latency for EU customers; service restored.' Will post once confirmed stable.

netops_lead: Confirmed: propagation converged by 03:42 UTC. Latency back to baseline ~80ms. No further action required for now.

sre_oncall: Closing pager. Follow-ups: post-incident writeup, add automated guard on TTLs, improve rollout monitoring for geo policies.

incident-bot: Pager closed by sre_oncall at 03:42 UTC. Duration: 27m.
